requirements.expectation: Independent frozen local build; retained G0 hashes and regressions

observations.allowed: valid isolated local frozen install/build and preserved G0 run
observations.denied: missing lock or changed protected G0 hashes reject
observations.recovery: clean restart reproduces same pinned source/definition

requirements.expectation: Deterministic test model, synthetic usage and no paid route

observations.allowed: fixed synthetic input invokes deterministic local model with synthetic units
observations.denied: supplier credentials/route/enabling flags invoke zero paid callbacks
observations.recovery: unknown model usage holds original reservation until owner receipt

requirements.expectation: Server identity and payer; current Space/source/audience and independent approver

observations.allowed: separate current operator and approver with two-end sharing allows
observations.denied: forged actor/payer/grant, expired approval or cross-Space denial before callbacks
observations.recovery: revocation invalidates cached bindings; explicit fresh grants restore legitimate work

requirements.expectation: Loopback HTTP and real SDK; current-authorized Task/command/event/result

observations.allowed: real loopback HTTP SDK creates and reads same Task/events/result
observations.denied: closed-wire forgery and stale ordinary commands reject before mutation
observations.recovery: lost acknowledgment queries original command; authorized snapshot resolves cursor gap

requirements.expectation: Local persistence, atomic outbox and restart; unknown blocks replay/continuation

observations.allowed: actual SQLite commit/outbox persists confirmed result
observations.denied: partial commit and deletion/revocation deny late publication
observations.recovery: restart conserves operation identity and settlement; pure replay invokes no model/effect

requirements.expectation: Native Task/Run, versioned plans and synthetic confirmed artifacts/checks

observations.allowed: versioned Ask/Plan and approved synthetic Run produces committed artifact
observations.denied: model self-approval, changed plan binding and workstation execution reject
observations.recovery: trusted unknown reconciliation precedes continuation and new Run after terminal

requirements.expectation: Current-authority Stop, stale progress exception and truthful offline delivery

observations.allowed: current authorized Stop admits stale progress and fences dispatch
observations.denied: cross-Space/revoked Stop rejects; offline stop displays Not delivered
observations.recovery: reconnect preserves unsent drafts without automatic submission/re-execution

requirements.expectation: Actual Web user flow using the running local service

observations.allowed: actual browser application executes required live-service flow
observations.denied: static page/source/build/screenshots without interaction do not qualify
observations.recovery: browser reconnect retrieves same Task/result and truthful pending state

requirements.expectation: Actual Electron application with restricted IPC/renderer/navigation

observations.allowed: actual Electron application executes required live-service flow
observations.denied: unsafe IPC/Node renderer/navigation reject; build only does not qualify
observations.recovery: desktop reconnect maintains same backend Task without hidden resume

requirements.expectation: Actual Android virtual-device native installation and interaction

observations.allowed: actual Android emulator installs/launches native app and performs flow
observations.denied: browser viewport or build only is not native interaction evidence
observations.recovery: native app reconnect observes same Task/result and truthful offline Stop

requirements.expectation: Official-source model cost proposal; no activation before approval

observations.allowed: current official-source proposal contains workload/token/cache/retry/region/USD math
observations.denied: unapproved proposal cannot activate paid route
observations.recovery: updated assumptions produce reviewed new proposal while default remains unpaid

requirements.expectation: Current-candidate evidence, independent formal assessment and honest future gates

observations.allowed: all actual scoped checks and registered assessments bind current candidate
observations.denied: missing UI evidence, failed mandatory branch or absent evaluator remains pending
observations.recovery: candidate changes invalidate affected observations and require current checks/reviews

testExecution.requiredNamedCases: All cases whose phase is at or before selected stage must execute exactly once; later phases remain unrequired.

uiEvidence.unavailableCapability: pending or concrete blocker; never pass

clients.outcome: pass only after execution; pending/fail blocks UI gate

steps.taskId: actual Task ID for create-task and later task flows
steps.revision: observed nonnegative integer for task flows

artifacts.path: existing screenshot/log file, absolute or repo-relative

schema.sharedTaskId: actual same backend Task whose confirmed result is read by all three clients

schema.p95Ms: nearest rank 95th measured duration; recomputed by checker

pendingQualification: paid API activation and region authorization
physical mobile device and real desktop sleep

candidateBinding.algorithm: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify({schemaVersion:1,files:[{path,sha256}]}) with files sorted by path
candidateBinding.files: existing requiredFiles beginning g1-local/ across every stage; evidence/docs/generated/node_modules excluded
candidateBinding.missingStageFiles: rejected by stage admission; earlier phases hash only currently present declared source files

cases.expected: Same fixed synthetic inputs produce same output/events/usage with deterministic-test labels.
Supplier/paid-route credentials or flags fail before supplier invocation; external invocation counter0.
Replay invokes zero models/effects and preserves unknown original operation/reservation.
Actor and payer derive from authenticated server identity; caller claims cannot replace them.
Membership/source revocation invalidates prior admission; current denied callback count0.
Either endpoint grant alone rejects0; both grants plus audience permit; omitted destination cannot bypass.
Operator cannot self-approve; different current authorized approver permits exact existing binding.
Expired approval or changed plan/input digest cannot execute synthetic effect; callback0.
Actual loopback service and SDK login/create/read return same immutable Task with local labels.
Forged actor/payer/permissions and partial/unknown commands reject without mutation.
Exact repeated actor/scope command returns original identity and one mutation; changed payload conflicts.
Duplicate/gap/expired cursor restores current authorized snapshot without unauthorized disclosure.
Actual SQLite transaction exception rolls back record/outbox/event together.
Close/reopen real database preserves committed record/outbox/result identities.
Duplicate delivery/receipt settles once and produces one synthetic artifact.
Incomplete bytes/manifest or interrupted owner state cannot publish a committed result.
Remote synthetic commit with lost ack keeps reservation unknown; trusted original lookup settles once without repeat.
Actual native Session with deterministic model produces separate answer/versioned plan; no workstation/remote dispatch.
Independent exact approval permits synthetic Run and committed artifact/check/result.
Changed requirements/plan or stale approval rejects effect before callback.
Terminal attempt cannot reopen; explicit retry creates new Run retaining evidence/charges.
Current authorized Stop accepts old expectedRevision and advances fence once.
Revoked/cross-Space Stop denies before cancellation/fence mutation.
After Stop, old-generation callbacks/publish reject; duplicate command returns original Stop receipt.
Connection loss reports Not delivered; reconnect queries original status and does not silently resend command/input/draft.
